verses.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.pt: ó insensatos gálatas! quem vos fascinou a vós, ante cujos olhos foi representado Jesus Cristo como crucificado?
verses.en_web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
verses.en_bbe: O foolish Galatians, by what strange powers have you been tricked, to whom it was made clear that Jesus Christ was put to death on the cross?

verses.en: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.pt: Só isto quero saber de vós: Foi por obras da lei que recebestes o Espírito, ou pelo ouvir com fé?
verses.en_web: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.en_bbe: Give me an answer to this one question, Did the Spirit come to you through the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.en: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.pt: Sois vós tão insensatos? tendo começado pelo Espírito, é pela carne que agora acabareis?
verses.en_web: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
verses.en_bbe: Are you so foolish? having made a start in the Spirit, will you now be made complete in the flesh?

verses.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.pt: Será que padecestes tantas coisas em vão? Se é que isso foi em vão.
verses.en_web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
verses.en_bbe: Did you undergo such a number of things to no purpose? if it is in fact to no purpose.

verses.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.pt: Aquele pois que vos dá o Espírito, e que opera milagres entre vós, acaso o faz pelas obras da lei, ou pelo ouvir com fé?
verses.en_web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.en_bbe: He who gives you the Spirit, and does works of power among you, is it by the works of law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.en: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.pt: Assim como Abraão creu a Deus, e isso lhe foi imputado como justiça.
verses.en_web: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
verses.en_bbe: Even as Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.pt: Sabei, pois, que os que são da fé, esses são filhos de Abraão.
verses.en_web: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: Be certain, then, that those who are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.

verses.en: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.pt: Ora, a Escritura, prevendo que Deus havia de justificar pela fé os gentios, anunciou previamente a boa nova a Abraão, dizendo: Em ti serão abençoadas todas as nações.
verses.en_web: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
verses.en_bbe: And the holy Writings, seeing before the event that God would give the Gentiles righteousness by faith, gave the good news before to Abraham, saying, In you will all the nations have a blessing.

verses.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.pt: De modo que os que são da fé são abençoados com o crente Abraão.
verses.en_web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: So then those who are of faith have a part in the blessing of Abraham who was full of faith.

verses.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.pt: Pois todos quantos são das obras da lei estão debaixo da maldição; porque escrito está: Maldito todo aquele que não permanece em todas as coisas que estão escritas no livro da lei, para fazê-las.
verses.en_web: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
verses.en_bbe: For all who are of the works of the law are under a curse: because it is said in the Writings, A curse is on everyone who does not keep on doing all the things which are ordered in the book of the law.

verses.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.pt: É evidente que pela lei ninguém é justificado diante de Deus, porque: O justo viverá da fé;
verses.en_web: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
verses.en_bbe: Now that no man gets righteousness by the law in the eyes of God, is clear; because, The upright will be living by faith.

verses.en: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.pt: ora, a lei não é da fé, mas: O que fizer estas coisas, por elas viverá.
verses.en_web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
verses.en_bbe: And the law is not of faith; but, He who does them will have life by them.

verses.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.pt: Cristo nos resgatou da maldição da lei, fazendo-se maldição por nós; porque está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que for pendurado no madeiro;
verses.en_web: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
verses.en_bbe: Christ has made us free from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: because it is said in the Writings, A curse on everyone who is put to death by hanging on a tree:

verses.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.pt: para que aos gentios viesse a bênção de Abraão em Jesus Cristo, a fim de que nós recebêssemos pela fé a promessa do Espírito.
verses.en_web: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.en_bbe: So that on the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; in order that we through faith might have the Spirit which God had undertaken to give.

verses.en: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.pt: Irmãos, como homem falo. Um testamento, embora de homem, uma vez confirmado, ninguém o anula, nem lhe acrescenta coisa alguma.
verses.en_web: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, as men would say, even a man's agreement, when it has been made certain, may not be put on one side, or have additions made to it.

verses.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.pt: Ora, a Abraão e a seu descendente foram feitas as promessas; não diz: E a seus descendentes, como falando de muitos, mas como de um só: E a teu descendente, que é Cristo.
verses.en_web: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Now to Abraham were the undertakings given, and to his seed. He says not, And to seeds, as of a great number; but as of one, he says, And to your seed, which is Christ.

verses.en: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.pt: E digo isto: Ao testamento anteriormente confirmado por Deus, a lei, que veio quatrocentos e trinta anos depois, não invalida, de forma a tornar inoperante a promessa.
verses.en_web: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
verses.en_bbe: Now this I say: The law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, does not put an end to the agreement made before by God, so as to make the undertaking without effect.

verses.en: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.pt: Pois se da lei provém a herança, já não provém mais da promessa; mas Deus, pela promessa, a deu gratuitamente a Abraão.
verses.en_web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
verses.en_bbe: Because if the heritage is by the law, it is no longer dependent on the word of God; but God gave it to Abraham by his word.

verses.en: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.pt: Logo, para que é a lei? Foi acrescentada por causa das transgressões, até que viesse o descendente a quem a promessa tinha sido feita; e foi ordenada por meio de anjos, pela mão de um mediador.
verses.en_web: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
verses.en_bbe: What then is the law? It was an addition made because of sin, till the coming of the seed to whom the undertaking had been given; and it was ordered through angels by the hand of a go-between.

verses.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.pt: Ora, o mediador não o é de um só, mas Deus é um só.
verses.en_web: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
verses.en_bbe: Now a go-between is not a go-between of one; but God is one.

verses.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.pt: É a lei, então, contra as promessas de Deus? De modo nenhum; porque, se fosse dada uma lei que pudesse vivificar, a justiça, na verdade, teria sido pela lei.
verses.en_web: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
verses.en_bbe: Is the law then against the words of God? in no way; because if there had been a law which was able to give life, truly righteousness would have been by the law.

verses.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.pt: Mas a Escritura encerrou tudo debaixo do pecado, para que a promessa pela fé em Jesus Cristo fosse dada aos que crêem.
verses.en_web: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.en_bbe: However, the holy Writings have put all things under sin, so that that for which God gave the undertaking, based on faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who have such faith.

verses.en: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.pt: Mas, antes que viesse a fé, estávamos guardados debaixo da lei, encerrados para aquela fé que se havia de revelar.
verses.en_web: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.en_bbe: But before faith came, we were kept in prison under the law, waiting for the revelation of the faith which was to come.

verses.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.pt: De modo que a lei se tornou nosso aio, para nos conduzir a Cristo, a fim de que pela fé fôssemos justificados.
verses.en_web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.en_bbe: So the law has been a servant to take us to Christ, so that we might have righteousness by faith.

verses.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.pt: Mas, depois que veio a fé, já não estamos debaixo de aio.
verses.en_web: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.en_bbe: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a servant.

verses.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Pois todos sois filhos de Deus pela fé em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Because you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.pt: Porque todos quantos fostes batizados em Cristo vos revestistes de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For all those of you who were given baptism into Christ did put on Christ.

verses.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Não há judeu nem grego; não há escravo nem livre; não há homem nem mulher; porque todos vós sois um em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: There is no Jew or Greek, servant or free, male or female: because you are all one in Jesus Christ.

verses.en: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.pt: E, se sois de Cristo, então sois descendência de Abraão, e herdeiros conforme a promessa.
verses.en_web: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
verses.en_bbe: And if you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed, and yours is the heritage by the right of God's undertaking given to Abraham.
